items.title: 《黑神话：钟馗》15分钟实机逐帧拆解
items.titleEn: Black Myth: Zhong Kui 15-Minute Gameplay Frame-by-Frame Breakdown
items.summary: blackmyth.game编辑部的逐帧拆解，将演示分为八段时间轴，区分官方文字、画面文字、可见画面和跨帧推理。确认了“大蚌真君”为官方HUD名称，白衣角色被编辑识别为年轻钟馗但官方未点名，并列出未确认清单（招架、召唤、双主角、坐骑等）。
items.summaryEn: Frame-by-frame breakdown by blackmyth.game editorial desk, dividing the demo into eight segments and separating official text, on-screen text, visible imagery, and cross-frame inference. Confirms 'Great Clam Lord' as official HUD name; identifies white-clad character as young Zhong Kui (editorial, not official); lists unconfirmed items (parry, summon, dual protagonists, mount).

provenance.originalTitle: 黑神話：鍾馗 15 分鐘實機拆解

evidence.supports: 提供逐帧拆解，确认HUD名称和未确认清单。
evidence.supportsEn: Provides frame-by-frame breakdown, confirms HUD name and unconfirmed list.

items.title: 《黑神话：钟馗》看起来不如《悟空》宏大——但这很好
items.titleEn: Black Myth: Zhong Kui Doesn’t Look as Epic as Wukong – and That’s Great
items.summary: IGN评论文章，作者Tim Brinkhof认为《钟馗》的实机演示显示出比《悟空》更接地气、更注重故事和角色的方向，虽然初看不如前作宏大，但越思考越喜欢。提到战斗新增招架机制，并认为游戏可能更注重剧情和角色。
items.summaryEn: IGN opinion piece by Tim Brinkhof, arguing that Zhong Kui's gameplay reveal shows a grittier, more grounded approach compared to Wukong, which initially seemed disappointing but becomes more appealing upon reflection. Mentions new parrying mechanic and suggests the game may focus more on story and characters.
